question.text: In Example 2, NAV increased from Rs. 1153.40 (June 30) to Rs. 1268.98 (July 31) primarily because:

answer.text: Market prices of most holdings increased; MTM captured gains

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Example 2, month-on-month NAV rise is driven by MTM capturing increases in market prices and the disposal of positions at gains. **The Trap:** Other reasons don't explain the month-on-month uplift. **Cross-Exam Context:** Standard MTM outcome. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Always explain NAV movement drivers (price vs transaction) in investor communication.
